description: SvPivotDesigner, the self-contained pivot authoring component for Svelte 5. You provide flat rows and a field list; it renders a left-rail field picker with search and dimension and measure grouping, the Filters, Columns, Rows and Values wells with HTML5 drag and drop, per-chip menus to pick an aggregator or the allowed filter values, a toolbar with Reset, presets, subtotal and grand-total toggles and an optional export hook, and an inline pivot grid driven by createPivotModel. One bindable layout prop lets the page persist it, restore it from a URL or sync it with other components.
keywords: svelte drag and drop pivot builder

faq.question: How do I persist the pivot layout?
faq.answer: Bind the layout prop. It is a plain object of the fields in each well with their aggregators and filters, so you can serialize it to localStorage or a URL and bind it back on load.

faq.question: Can I add an export button?
faq.answer: Yes. Pass an onExport hook and the toolbar shows Export; the hook receives the layout and the pivot rows, which you can hand to the enterprise exportData.

faq.question: How do presets work?
faq.answer: Give the designer an array of named layouts; the preset menu applies one by replacing the bound layout, and Reset returns to the initial one.
